title: de.bias
summary: de.bias is a Google Cloud-native fairness engineering platform that generates synthetic credit-lending data, injects historical bias, applies a four-layer mitigation pipeline, and evaluates data- and model-level fairness with Gemini-authored compliance reports. It runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer (via sdv.single_table and sdv.metadata.SingleTableMetadata) to produce the realistic baseline credit dataset before bias is injected.
